definitions.explanation: the quality of being continuous or unbroken; the state of things being connected without interruption

examples.japanese: ⟦ストーリー→ストーリー：11018_sutoorii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{連続性|れんぞくせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: The continuity of the story is important.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{連続性|れんぞくせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}けている→欠ける：13167_kakeru⟧。

⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{連続性|れんぞくせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{理解|りかい}する→理解する：06059_rikaisuru⟧ことで、⟦{現在|げんざい}→現在：01556_genzai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦どのように→どのように：23674_donoyouni⟧⟦{形成|けいせい}→形成：12541_keisei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えて→見える：01165_mieru⟧くる。
examples.english: By understanding the continuity of history, you can see how present-day society was formed.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{連続|れんぞく}→連続：03783_renzoku⟧ (continuation; series) + ⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ (nature; quality). Describes the abstract quality of things being connected or ongoing without gaps. Used widely in academic, technical, and everyday contexts when discussing whether something maintains an unbroken flow.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連続性|れんぞくせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have continuity
- {連続性|れんぞくせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}ける→欠ける：13167_kakeru⟧: to lack continuity
- {連続性|れんぞくせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧: to maintain continuity
- {連続性|れんぞくせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確保|かくほ}→確保：13681_kakuho⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to ensure continuity
- ⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{連続性|れんぞくせい}: business continuity

USAGE:
The suffix ⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ turns ⟦{連続|れんぞく}→連続：03783_renzoku⟧ from "continuation" (a concrete process) into "continuity" (an abstract quality). This is a productive pattern in Japanese: ⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧ (safety) → ⟦{安全性|あんぜんせい}→安全性：19384_anzensei⟧ (the quality of being safe), ⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧ (important) → ⟦{重要性|じゅうようせい}→重要性：04823_juuyousei⟧ (importance).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{連続|れんぞく}→連続：03783_renzoku⟧: continuation; series — the base word, referring to the act or state of continuing
- ⟦{一貫性|いっかんせい}→一貫性：05575_ikkansei⟧: consistency — emphasizes logical coherence rather than temporal continuity
- ⟦{持続性|じぞくせい}→持続性：21748_jizokusei⟧: sustainability; durability — emphasizes lasting over time
